questions.question: Define interpretivist approach. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Interpretivist approach focuses on understanding subjective meanings individuals
  • attach to social actions.

questions.question: Explain Citation. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • Citation refers to acknowledging sources of information used in research work.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define probability sampling. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Probability sampling is a method where each unit has a known chance of selection.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define narrative analysis. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Narrative analysis studies stories to understand lived experiences and meanings.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define systematic inquiry. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Systematic inquiry is an organized and methodical investigation to generate
  • knowledge.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define voluntary participation. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Voluntary participation means respondents take part in research without coercion.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain research problem. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • A research problem is a clearly defined issue that guides a study.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define experimental group. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Experimental group is the group exposed to the independent variable.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define data editing. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Data editing involves checking and correcting collected data for accuracy.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Define value neutrality. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Value neutrality means maintaining objectivity and avoiding bias in research.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the characteristics of social research. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Social research is systematic, empirical, and logical in nature.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain operationalization. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • Operationalization converts abstract concepts into measurable variables.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain structured interview. / [CO3] [3x10 = 30]
questions.solution_html: • Structured interview uses pre-set questions asked in a fixed order.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the characteristics of research report. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• A research report presents findings in a systematic and structured manner. It includes
  • methodology, analysis, and conclusions based on evidence.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the practical problems faced during fieldwork. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Fieldwork often faces issues such as access, bias, and ethical challenges. Time,
  • resources, and respondent cooperation also affect data collection.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Analyse the main ideas of empiricism in research. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Empiricism emphasizes knowledge based on observation and experience. It forms the
  • foundation of scientific research.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Evaluate the importance of proper referencing. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Proper referencing ensures academic credibility and transparency. It also helps avoid
  • plagiarism and acknowledges sources.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Write down the difference of questionnaire and interview schedule. / [CO3] [8x5 = 40]
questions.solution_html:
• A questionnaire is self-administered, whereas an interview schedule is conducted by
  • the researcher. They differ in flexibility, interaction, and depth of responses.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
